He added this aboue al.''] The fault of Princes and other great men, that can not only not abide to heare their faults, but also punish by death or emprisonment such as reprehend them for the same (specially if they warne them, as Prophets and Priests doe, from God) is exceding great.

''23. Of Heli.''] {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The reconciliation of Matthew and Luke in our Sauiours petigree.}}Whereas in S. Matthevv, Iacob is father to Ioseph, and here Heli, the case was thus. Mathan (named in S. Matthevv) of his wife called Escha begat Iacob: and after his death, Melchi (named here in S. Luke) of the same vvoman begat Heli: so that Iacob and Heli were brethren of one mother. This Heli therfore marrying and dying vvithout issue: Iacob his brother, according to the Lavv married his vvife, and begat Ioseph, and so raised vp seede to his brother Heli. Whereby it came to passe, that Iacob was the natural father of Ioseph, which as (S. Matthew saith) begat him: and Heli vvas his legal father according to the Law, as S. Luke signifieth. ''Euseb. li. 1 Ec. Hist. c. 7 Hiero. in c. 1 Mat. Aug. li. 2 c. 2. 3 de cons. Euang''.

{{c|''Christ going into the Desert to prepare him self before his manifestation, ouercommeth the tentations of the Diuel. 14. then beginning gloriously in Galilee, 16. he sheweth to them of Nazareth his commission out of Esay the Prophet, 23. insinuating by occasion the Ievves his countrimens reprobation. 31. In Capharnaum his doctrine is admired, 33. specially for his miracle in the Synagogue. 38. from vvhich, going to Peters house, he shevveth there much more povver. 42. Then retiring into the vvildernesse, he preacheth aftervvard to the other cities of Galilee.''}} {{dropinitial|A|fl={{verse|chapter=4|verse=1}}}}ND {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 4, 1. Mr. 1, 12.''}}* {{sc|Iesvs}} ful of the Holy Ghost, returned from Iordan, and vvas driuen in the spirit into the desert, {{verse|chapter=4|verse=2}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Chuches fast of 40 daies (called Lent) commeth of this, & is an Apostolical Tradition. ''Clem. Constit. Apost. li. 5 c. 13. Hier. ep. ad Marcel. adu erro. Montani. Leo ser. 6 et 9 de Quadrages''.}}∷ fourtie daies, and vvas tempted of the deuil. And he did eate nothing in those daies: and vvhen they vvere ended, he vvas an hungred. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=3}}† And the Deuil said to him, If thou be the sonne of God, say to this stone that it be made bread. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=4}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} made ansvver vnto him, It is vvritten, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deuter. 8, 3.''}}* ''That not in bread alone shal man liue, but in euery vvord of God''. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=5}}† And the Deuil brought him into an high mountaine, and shevved him al the kingdoms of the vvhole vvorld in a moment of time: {{verse|chapter=4|verse=6}}† and he said to him, To thee vvil I giue this vvhole povver, and the glorie of them: for to me they are deliuered, and to vvhom I vvil, I doe giue them. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=7}}† Thou therfore if thou vvilt adore before me, they shal al be thine. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=8}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvering said to him, It is vvritten, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deu. 6, 13. 10, 20.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ See the Annot. in S. Matthew c. 4, 11.}}∷ ''Thou shalt adore the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou '' {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''λατρεύσεις.''}}∷ ''serue''. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=9}}† And he brought him into Hierusalem, and set him vpon the pinnacle of the temple: and he said to him, If thou be the sonne of God, cast thy self from hence dovvnevvard. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=10}}† For {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Psal. 90, 11.''}}* it is written, that {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ If the Diuel him self alleage Scripture against Christ, no maruel that Heretikes do so against Christs Church.}}∷ ''He hath giuen his Angels''<noinclude>{{rh||T|charge}}</noinclude>
